title: Validate POST /invoices bodies
prompt: POST /invoices accepts anything, so a body without a customer or with a negative quantity is stored and later blows up in the totals. Add request validation: customer is a non-empty string, currency is a three-letter uppercase code, lines is a non-empty array, each line has a non-empty description, an integer quantity >= 0 and an integer unitPriceCents >= 0. On failure respond 400 with `{ error: { field, message } }` naming the first offending field (for example `lines[0].quantity`). Put the validation in its own module under src/http/ and unit test it directly as well as through the router.
